card.albumInvite: Add your photo memories. They stay up until {date}.

album.title: Photo album
album.subtitle: Temporary photos — deleted on {date}
album.intro: Turn the album on so guests and the committee can share photo memories. Photos are shrunk to load fast without losing sharpness, and deleted after the event.

album.guestUploadsHint: From their card; up to 20 photos each
album.uploaded: {count, plural, one {# photo added} other {# photos added}}
album.someFailed: {count, plural, one {# photo did not upload} other {# photos did not upload}}. Try again.
album.tooBig: The photo is larger than 15 MB.
album.notImage: This file is not a photo.
album.compressNote: We shrink photos without losing sharpness.
album.deleteConsequence: It will be removed from the album for everyone.
album.clearConsequence: {count, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}} will be deleted now for everyone. This cannot be undone.
album.closed: The album is closed and its photos have been deleted.
album.guestUploadsOff: Only the hosts can add photos.
album.privacy: Only people with a card for this event can see the photos. They are deleted on {date}.
